repos_data.description: Self-hosted MCP server for live documentation, code audits, and best practices. 598+ curated libraries, 100+ audit patterns, no rate limits.
Production ready MCP server with real-time search & extract in Google, Amazon, YouTube, Walmart, Reddit, TikTok and Instagram
A mcp server to allow LLMS gain context about shadcn ui component structure,usage and installation,compaitable with react,svelte 5,vue & React Native
MCP server for the PostStack Email API — 84 tools, 5 prompts, 5 resources for AI agents.
An open-source DevUtils MCP Server — a comprehensive developer utilities toolkit for the Docker MCP Catalog. It provides 36 tools across 8 categories that AI assistants can invoke directly.
MCP server for Sofya. Web search, fetch, extract, and deep research.
Trello integration for Claude Desktop via Model Context Protocol (MCP) - 19 tools for comprehensive board, card, and list management
MCP server for GitHunt - search, rank, and analyze GitHub developers from Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client
Local-first MCP gateway. One port for every tool and every AI client: lazy discovery (~90% token savings), tool integrity + quarantine, secrets in the OS keychain.

Model Context Protocol server for Firefox DevTools - enables AI assistants to inspect and control Firefox browser through the Remote Debugging Protocol

repo_meta_data.description: It's like v0, but in your Cursor / Claude Code / Windsurf: search 10,000+ React/Tailwind components, generate new UI with AI, and publish your own — right from your editor. Magic MCP is now the 21st MCP; this package keeps old configs working. Setup: 21st.dev/mcp
